verdict.rationale: LegalOS's own marketing says it organizes employer and candidate materials in one structured workflow, uses a guided intake flow, helps collect evidence, and maps evidence to O-1 criteria, so structured collection is claimed. The mechanics the story names are never described, and the claims are high-level marketing copy only. Missing for 10: explicit checklists, document upload functionality, automated reminders/nudges, any detail on how collection replaces email, independent or hands-on corroboration.
